name: Simple Twist
description: The confessional Blood on the Tracks move from Simple Twist of Fate: a chromatic descent on the tonic (I to Imaj7 to I7) down into the subdominant, then the borrowed minor iv darkening the return home. The IV-to-iv darkening recurs in Make You Feel My Love.
source: Bob Dylan, via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets (Simple Twist of Fate; minor-iv corroborated by Make You Feel My Love)
